name: loitering_multizone_01
notes: Two synchronized views of the same CAVIAR OneShopOneWait1 event. Official XML labels a person waiting/browsing; pipeline probes confirm continuous tracks exceed 20 s in both views. Technique context: Nunez et al., Identifying Loitering Behavior With Trajectory Analysis, WACV Workshops 2024, pp. 251-259. Dataset: EC-funded CAVIAR project IST 2001 37540, CC BY-SA. This is a coordination demo, not an independent real-world evaluation sample.
